tools.name: get_trace_schema
tools.description: Return the exact input format TraceCheck's evaluate_trace expects, the scored dimensions and weights, and a complete example call you can copy. Call this once before your first evaluate_trace. No arguments, no side effects.

tools.name: evaluate_trace
tools.description: Verify my run / self-check: did I succeed? Get an independent, deterministic reliability score (0-100) for a multi-step task you (an agent) just ran, before reporting success. Evaluates the trace, detects loops, unrecovered errors and success claimed without evidence, and returns concrete fixes for

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: evaluate_trace · Private data: evaluate_trace · Public sink: evaluate_trace · Destructive: get_trace_schema, evaluate_trace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: evaluate_trace · Private data: evaluate_trace · Public sink: evaluate_trace · Destructive: get_trace_schema, evaluate_trace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "evaluate_trace" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
